sources.description: Builds and validates candidate manifests and verification ledgers.
Exercises candidate-evidence rejection behavior from a separate regression source.
Owns exact-head production verification and candidate artifact fan-out.
Runs repository-local verification of orchestration contracts.
Shared Git object database and command-line implementation used by candidate checks.
GitHub-hosted immutable pull-request head identity supplied to workflows.

signals.description: The candidate-evidence regression observes rejection after substituting a different candidate SHA.
The orchestration workflow independently runs on the pull-request head identity while producing EV advisory evidence.

proofRecords.description: Candidate evidence rejects a forged proof SHA, but the observation still executes the implementation under test.
A separate workflow observes the exact pull-request head identity through GitHub and Git infrastructure.

criteria.description: Candidate evidence must reject proof records bound to a different candidate SHA.
Candidate verification workflows must run against the immutable pull-request head revision rather than a synthetic merge revision.
